firstTranscript.name: Night Court, The Anaconda Empress, The Anaconda Empress, Nevermore

lines.text: 🚨 Night Court, The Anaconda Empress, The Anaconda Empress, Nevermore is at Haven's door. The village looks to you. Four ways to call: a RUNNER (slow, dangerous), a SIGNAL FIRE (fast, loud, everyone sees), the SYSTEM RELAY (if it can carry voices), or an ABILITY CRY (if your build has one). Each with honest costs.
📓 Codex: Night Court, The Anaconda Empress, The Anaconda Empress, Nevermore at the door, day 10.
📖 The Codex settles deeper into you. It knows things before you do now. Deaths, especially — it will tell you itself.
📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Nevermore is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
🛡️ Ricardo, Paola, Jayden and Antonio met them at the door — 1 put down, 3 driven off. Ricardo, Antonio are hurt.
One of them is coming for YOU — Night Court, inside the haven, eyes on your bedroll.
Days later, you'll hear what happened out past the ridge. For now: nothing. The village keeps its face still.
A sharp-eyed peddler waits a while, then moves on down the road. Word travels about that, too.
🐺 HOWLS in the distance. Closer than before. The System chirps: "Oh! We made those! Are they... too many? We can make fewer?" (New monster: hushwolf pack.)
Rain. Steady, cold, honest rain.
⚠ STARVING: health and energy falling. The spiral has started.

◈ "UNIT SEARCH LOCKET — [TRANSLATION COMPLETE] — we have been watching you carry this. Attachment waveform: significant. Function decoded: +resolve when worn. You knew it mattered before we did. Cute."

◈ FLASHBACK — Search locket
The last photo, the one where they're laughing at something off-camera. You'll ask the System what it wants, later. First: them.
📖 The memory leaves something behind: You are looking. That counts for something.
💛 The Search locket is starting to do something. (Keepsake L1 — quiet luck: 1 in 5 misses lands anyway, while worn.)

◈ "UNIT DISPATCHER'S HEADSET — [TRANSLATION COMPLETE] — we have been watching you carry this. Attachment waveform: significant. Function decoded: +resolve when worn; calm under pressure. You knew it mattered before we did. Cute."

◈ FLASHBACK — Dispatcher's headset
You learned the voice — low, steady, unhurried. 'Panic is just information arriving too fast.' You hear it in your own voice now when it counts.
📖 The memory leaves something behind: You read bad situations early. It is training.
💛 The Dispatcher's headset is starting to do something. (Keepsake L1 — resolve: trauma lands a quarter lighter, while worn.)

◈ "UNIT BUSKER'S HARMONICA — [TRANSLATION COMPLETE] — we have been watching you carry this. Attachment waveform: significant. Function decoded: +resolve when worn; music steadies the camp. You knew it mattered before we did. Cute."

◈ FLASHBACK — Busker's harmonica
Rain, an open case, three dollars and a sandwich. You played anyway — the street owes you nothing, so everything it gives is a gift. You still believe that.
📖 The memory leaves something behind: Music steadies hands. Yours, and the camp’s.
💛 The Busker's harmonica is starting to do something. (Keepsake L1 — quiet luck: 1 in 5 misses lands anyway, while worn.)

◈ "UNIT DEAD PHONE — [TRANSLATION COMPLETE] — we have been watching you carry this. Attachment waveform: significant. Function decoded: +resolve when worn (morale). You knew it mattered before we did. Cute."

◈ FLASHBACK — Dead Phone
Cracked screen, 2% forever. The last text, unsent: 'call when you can.' It was from Benjamin — your brother. You have carried the unsent message for years. Maybe he is still out there.
📖 The memory leaves something behind: Your brother — last known heading west. Someone, somewhere, might have seen him.
💛 The Dead Phone is starting to do something. (Keepsake L1 — quiet luck: 1 in 5 misses lands anyway, while worn.)
Village meal: +1098 kcal, +1L water from the communal pantry. (Half ration — they don't trust you yet.)
Ingrid drew American Ginseng in the dirt for the others. It'll wash away. The knowledge won't.
Ricardo traded something with someone for something else. The barter economy stirs.
Ingrid and Jayden lingered over the fire together.
Brian and Paola lingered over the fire together.
Sari and Ingrid lingered over the fire together.
🍽️ Xavier eyes the groaning pantry shelves and packs light today. "No point hauling what'll rot. Mending the nets instead."
🍽️ Petra looks at the full shelves and waves off the day's share. "No more into the store — we eat at the fire, and the shelves keep."
🤒 Xavier is achy and wrung out, barely eating. Rest and clean water — or it gets worse.
— DAY 11 DAWN — The world wakes. Animals are active.
Hunger gnaws. The pack is thin — work the green, haul it back, get it named at camp. That's the whole game.
You wake with a start — something is wrong.
◈ CRISIS — THE BREACH. It got INSIDE. The haven was supposed to be the safe place — the one place. It isn’t.
SYSTEM: "Perimeter violated! This is unprecedented! ...Is this unprecedented? Checking. Yes. Unprecedented."
Two eyes, forward-facing, unblinking. No wingsound. Owls don't make sound when they hunt — that's the problem.
The village is rattled. Everyone's jumpy — eyes on the treeline.
You don't know what that was. The absence of sound, shaped like wings. Someone at the haven should hear about this.
⚔ NIGHT COURT! You're on your own.
Turn-based now. Tap a tile to move — speed is squares. Then act.
The moon-shadow is growing under you. Silent dive. MOVE.
Spent, wings dragging — it takes the hit badly. (+50% while grounded)
You STRIKE the owl for 17.
📺 +5 style — solid hit
💥 Adjournment!
Owl's Adjournment hits you for 18.
It lands on its kill — wings mantling, head turned too far. It stands there, breathing. Grounded.
📖 Codex: Adjournment — strikes one target after a windup. You won't forget this.
Spent, wings dragging — it takes the hit badly. (+50% while grounded)
owl is BLEEDING — and it likes it. Louder, faster, no more feints.
You STRIKE the owl for 21.
📺 +5 style — solid hit
Two dives and nothing. It pants — owls shouldn't pant. NOW.
You STRIKE the owl for 23.
📺 +5 style — solid hit
It blinks — once, slowly — and the night takes it back. Gone, upward.
It's high overhead — out of your hands reach. Watch the shadow, not the owl.
The moon-shadow is growing under you. Silent dive. MOVE.
Spent, wings dragging — it takes the hit badly. (+50% while grounded)
The Night Court falls.
You STRIKE the owl for 15.
📺 +5 style — solid hit
📺 +20 style — dropped the Night Court!

Owl. Tastes like chicken that judged you first. It's dead. The carcass is there on the ground — search the body if you want the meat. But you don't know this flesh. Clean it, test it cautiously, or ask someone who knows. And don't leave it long: meat rots where it lies.
You came back bloody. Nobody asks. Someone saves you the good seat by the fire.
You clutch your Field suture kit, Search locket, Dispatcher's headset, Busker's harmonica, Dead Phone. You're still here.
◈ TRIAL RECOGNIZED — the System has been watching. You WON a fight. Not survived — won. The audience is still standing. So are you. (Combat track +)
You are full enough.
The pantry is in the hall. Your hands are not.
No risky water to boil.
Drank clean water.
📋 Noah — 💧 Fetch water. They'll report back by next part.
🌱 Ricardo waters and weeds the beds before taking up other work. The harvest can wait.

🌿 Ricardo checks the pantry before heading out — the shelves are full, ~9 days of fresh on hand… leaves the harvest standing and turns to the stone pile instead. The pantry can't take more; the wild will keep.
🪨 Ricardo pries 1 stone loose from the creek bed. The building pile grows. (2 stone now.)
💧 Noah returns with 11L of creek water. Risky until the hearth boils it.
You catch fragments by the fire — Ingrid telling Ricardo about Paola. The story's getting bigger than what happened.
Nancy showed Brian the Pokeweed — "remember it." Word gets around.
Noah showed Ricardo the Bitter Manioc — "remember it." Word gets around.
Jayden showed Sari the Feral Paddy Rice — "remember it." Word gets around.
💬 Ricardo has been asking Paola about Iron Stomach — what it does, what it goes with. Planning something.
🚶 Noah is back — found Ricardo.
🩹 Antonio is still hurting (42 HP) — no healer at haven. They rest today instead of ranging out.
🩹 Ingrid is still hurting (66 HP) — no healer at haven. They rest today instead of ranging out.
🩹 Brian is still hurting (58 HP) — no healer at haven. They rest today instead of ranging out.
Paola is working the broom along the hall floor, slow and thorough.
Iron cold. Even the ticks are shelved.
— MIDDAY — Honest work hours. Heat builds.
You wait. The light changes. Nothing asks anything of you.
📋 Noah — 💧 Fetch water. They'll report back by next part.
Antonio watches you give the order. "Interesting. Nobody asked me."
💧 Noah returns with 3L of creek water. Risky until the hearth boils it.
You catch fragments by the fire — Ricardo telling Sari about you. Someone's added a flourish that wasn't there this morning.
You catch fragments by the fire — Noah telling Paola about Sari. The retelling is already better than the event.
👥 Noah heads out for water. "The well won't fill itself."
Petra is working the cookpot, tasting, adjusting.
Nora is at the cookpot, tasting off the spoon, frowning, adding a pinch of something.
— DUSK — Animals stir again. Shadows lengthen.
The door is quiet. Haven breathes.
◈ CRISIS — THE SIEGE. They came in the night for the pantry — and the village met them at the door with blades and fire and drove them back into the dark. Wealth has a scent. So does defiance.
SYSTEM: "INTRUDER REPELLED. The pantry’s aroma is now classified as a defensive liability. The audience is chanting the defenders’ names. Fan clubs are forming. This is how it starts."
🛟 Paola stands up by the fire. "We take the hit and we answer it — standing here isn't an answer. Here's what we CAN do — pick one, maybe two, but everything costs something."
"Tend the hurt, stretch the food, or hunt it back — pick one, maybe two, but everything costs something."
"Or we rally," Paola adds. "Second shift, everybody. We work, we eat, we live — and we pay for it."
(Relief is open — triage, rations, hunt, or rally, from the beats row. Each option works once; the moment passes in ~3 days.)
📓 Codex: Paola proposed relief (raid), day 11.
You wait. The light changes. Nothing asks anything of you.
📋 Noah — 💧 Fetch water. They'll report back by next part.
💧 Noah eyes the cistern — full to the brim. No sense hauling water there's no room for; they turn to the wood run instead.
🪵 Noah hauls back 5 wood. The pile grows. (33 logs now.)
You catch fragments by the fire — Ingrid telling Paola about you. Half of it's true anymore. You're not sure which half.
